description: This Python module provides a comprehensive pipeline for processing and correcting subtitles. It includes normalization, optional grammar and style corrections, OTT compliance enforcement, and audio or transcript-based adjustments using speech recognition. The script leverages optional dependencies like language_tool_python, textstat, whisper, and faster_whisper to enhance functionality, but gracefully handles their absence. It is designed to be integrated into a larger subtitle processing system, with extensive customization options via parameters.

methods.name: List[Dict] correct_subtitles_pipeline( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", enable_grammar: bool = True, enable_ott_rules: bool = True, enable_audio_correction: bool = False, audio_source: Optional[str] = None, asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, transcript: Optional[List[Dict]] = None, )
methods.description: Main function orchestrating normalization, grammar corrections, OTT compliance, and audio/transcript-based adjustments for subtitle cues.

methods.name: str _normalize_text(text: str)
methods.description: Performs whitespace normalization and punctuation spacing adjustments.

methods.name: None _apply_grammar_and_spell_corrections(cues: List[Dict], language: str = "en")
methods.description: Uses language_tool_python to correct grammar and spelling in subtitles if available.

methods.name: bool _is_change_reasonable(original: str, corrected: str)
methods.description: Determines if the correction made is conservatively acceptable using fuzzy matching heuristics.

methods.name: None _apply_ott_compliance_rules( cues: List[Dict], *, language: str = "en", max_lines_per_cue: int = 2, max_chars_per_line: int = 42, enforce_terminal_punctuation: bool = False, )
methods.description: Enforces baseline OTT rules such as line length limits, line count, terminal punctuation, and reading speed heuristics.

methods.name: List[str] _wrap_text(text: str, max_chars: int, max_lines: int)
methods.description: Wraps text into lines respecting max characters and number of lines.

methods.name: str _adjust_for_reading_speed(text: str)
methods.description: Refines text layout based on reading speed heuristics when textstat is available.

methods.name: None _apply_transcript_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], transcript: List[Dict], )
methods.description: Adjusts cues based on an external transcript to improve alignment.

methods.name: List[Dict] _normalize_transcript_segments(transcript: List[Dict])
methods.description: Normalizes different transcript formats into a consistent list of segments with timing and text.

methods.name: None _apply_audio_aware_corrections( cues: List[Dict], *, audio_source: Optional[str], language: str = "en", asr_model_name: Optional[str] = None, asr_device: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Performs audio-based correction by transcribing audio, then harmonizing subtitle text with the ASR output.

methods.name: List[Dict] _run_asr( audio_source: str, *, language: str, model_name: Optional[str], device: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Runs ASR transcription via available backends (faster-whisper preferred, fallback to whisper) and returns time-synced segments.

methods.name: str _collect_asr_text_for_window(segments: List[Dict], start: float, end: float)
methods.description: Concatenates ASR segments overlapping with a specified time window.

methods.name: float _timestamp_to_seconds(ts: str)
methods.description: Converts timestamp string of format HH:MM:SS,mmm to float seconds.

methods.name: str _harmonize_text_with_asr(sub_text: str, asr_text: str)
methods.description: Uses fuzzy matching to replace tokens in subtitle text with close ASR tokens, aiming for better alignment of misheard words.

methods.name: List[str] _tokenize(text: str)
methods.description: Splits text into words and punctuation tokens while preserving punctuation as separate tokens.

methods.name: str _detokenize(tokens: List[str])
methods.description: Rejoins tokens into a string with appropriate spacing.

methods.name: str _match_casing(source: str, template: str)
methods.description: Matches the casing style of the source string to that of a template string.

methods.name: bool _overlaps(a_start: float, a_end: float, b_start: float, b_end: float)
